{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Red Star is a Marxist-Leninist caucus in DSA.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The primary goal of Red Star is to abolish capitalism and ultimately achieve communism.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Red Star does not believe that capitalism can be reformed into socialism; it must be overthrown and replaced.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Red Star conceives of itself as an ideological center in DSA.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"As a center, Red Star works from a practical and coherent position to push DSA toward a shared vision through organizing, developing DSA members, polemics, and engagement with DSA’s internal democratic processes.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Red Star seeks to cohere a vanguard party.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Red Star believes DSA can foster the creation of a vanguard party.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"DSA’s resources, broad membership, organizing ethic, and robust democratic processes make it, out of all existing US socialist organizations, the best incubator for a vanguard party.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Red Star is Marxist-Leninist.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"Red Star understands Marxism as a living, breathing theoretical framework that is not and never can be a static set of dogmas.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[6]},{"claim_text":"Red Star sees Marxism as the foundational and most informative lens through which to understand the workings of capitalism.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[6]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
